messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick debrief from Helios onboarding — short thread, want help triaging feature asks before I put them in the backlog.

Maya (CSM): TL;DR: 3 repeat asks + 2 edge pain points. Customer is worried about seat-level billing, per-route cost visibility, and an exportable audit trail for inference decisions.

Lena (CSE): can you paste the raw asks/quotes? I can try to map to existing work.

Maya (CSM): Pasted from notes: 
- "We need per-user toggles for billing so finance doesn't get surprise charges."
- "Hard to see which route is burning tokens — need per-route cost breakdown in console."
- "Export of decision logs for redaction & audits — must include model version + prompt hash."
- "Batch job errors are opaque, customers want retry/visibility hooks."
- "Sometimes responses timeout and we lose the trace — TTL on traces would help."

Maya (CSM): They ranked per-user billing as highest, per-route cost second. Audit export is a blocker for compliance review (they paused proof-of-concept).

Jon (PM): Thanks — can we use the quick triage rubric? Impact/Feasibility/Regulatory. From the sound of it: per-user billing = High impact / Medium feasibility; per-route cost = High impact / Low effort; audit export = High impact / Medium-high effort (regulatory).

Alex (Product): Agree with Jon. If per-route cost is low effort we should treat it as a fast win. Does Helios need dashboard-level docs or an API first?

Maya (CSM): They asked for both — dashboard for CSMs and API for their finance automation.

Lena (CSE): Proposed quick capture template (paste this into the ticket):
```
PROBLEM | CUSTOMER QUOTE | TOPOLOGY IMPACT | SUGGESTED DELIVERY | URGENCY
Per-user billing | "no one gets notified about seat usage" | affects billing/revenue | add billing toggle + seat usage export (API + UI) | P0
Per-route cost | "which route is burning tokens?" | cost attribution for product teams | per-route cost column + CSV export | P1
Audit export | "need prompt hashes + model version" | compliance/regulatory | add export of decision logs with redaction hooks | P0
```
Jon (PM): Good. I'll create tickets and tag as: billing-team, infra-costing, compliance. Can we attach the onboarding transcript?

Maya (CSM): Attaching short excerpt below (copied). Also adding notes on timelines — customer needs compliance artifact by end of quarter.

Maya (CSM): Excerpt: "If we can't prove how a decision was made and tie it to a model + prompt, legal won't sign off."

Alex (Product): If timeline is EoQ, we should fast-track per-route cost dashboard (quick dev + rollout) and start scoping audit export with compliance. I'll allocate a small spike for redaction rules.

Lena (CSE): For infra: recommend we surface cached vs cold tokens in cost calc (helps explain variance). Also add a flag to include/exclude prefix caching when computing per-route costs.

Jon (PM): Action items: I will open 3 tickets (billing toggle, per-route cost, audit export) and tag Maya for acceptance criteria. Can everyone add one sentence on acceptance by EOD?

Maya (CSM): Added acceptance criteria to the thread below and will follow up with Helios on exact CSV columns.

synth-bot: deployment-report: new ticket created #CS-3142 (per-route-cost), assigned Jon.

Lena (CSE): +1 on acceptance, will add recommended CSV columns (route_id, model_version, token_count, cached_tokens, cost_estimate)

Alex (Product): +1 — will add model versioning behavior in ticket notes.

Maya (CSM): Thanks team :heart: — will update customer and track renewal risk until audit export path is clear.

Jon (PM): I'll update roadmap board and set a canary release for per-route cost next sprint. :thumbsup:
